subject: [PATCH v9 1/7] mm/memcontrol: flatten try_charge_memcg control flow

2026-11-13.patch_summary: This patch refactors the try_charge_memcg function in mm/memcontrol.c to simplify its control flow by separating the logic for memsw and memory page counters into distinct paths. This makes it easier to follow the code, especially when page_counter_try_charge is made stock-aware. The change does not introduce any functional changes.
